steps.label: Opt-in isolation
steps.sub: NetworkPolicy adds firewall-like rules per Pod

code:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-all
  namespace: payments
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
caption: An empty podSelector matches every Pod in the namespace; no rules listed means nothing gets in or out.

code:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-checkout-to-payments
  namespace: payments
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payment-processing
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: checkout
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 8443
caption: Policies are additive — this narrow allow rule combines with the default-deny to permit only checkout traffic in.
